summary: Frontend regression test for session-persistence fix on /partner-engineer (iOS Safari backgrounded-tab bug). All 4 scenarios passed end-to-end on the preview env.

test_1_partner_engineer_reload_persisten.detail: Logged in as admin@gymaxisai.com, navigated to /partner-engineer, performed 3 consecutive page.reload(wait_until=networkidle) with 3.5s settle. URL remained https://comms-email-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/partner-engineer on every reload — NO bounce to /login. Core regression fix verified.

test_2a_dashboard_reload.detail: Navigated to /dashboard (legitimately module-redirected to /master-admin for master_admin). Reload kept user on /master-admin — no /login bounce.

test_2b_svc_engineer_reload.detail: Navigated to /svc/engineer; reload settled back on /svc/engineer (no /login bounce). Confirms /svc/engineer was already in protectedPrefixes and still works.

test_3_no_token_redirects_to_login.detail: Cleared localStorage.token then navigated to /partner-engineer. URL became /login?next=/partner-engineer — gate correctly redirects users without a session. The hasSessionToken splash does NOT trap users without a token.

test_4_public_root_renders_logged_out.detail: With no token, navigating to / rendered the full GymAxis marketing landing page (hero 'Smarter Fitness. Stronger Business.', nav, CTAs). Not stuck on a Loading splash.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js fix (lines 566-584) is correct: hasSessionToken || isProtectedRoute gate shows splash; non-protected + no-token paths skip the splash and render normally. protectedPrefixes now includes '/partner-engineer' and '/partners' as described.

Console shows pre-existing CSP violations blocking 3rd-party scripts (assets.emergent.sh/emergent-main.js, posthog, cloudflareinsights) — unrelated to this fix but worth tracking separately (CSP script-src missing those origins).
test_credentials: admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123! (master_admin) — used as instructed; any logged-in user passes the /partner-engineer route guard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The session-persistence fix in App.js lines 566-584 is verified: hasSessionToken from localStorage holds the loading splash for any path while /auth/me is in flight, preventing the /partner-engineer route guard from prematurely flashing user=null and redirecting to /login. Reload-persistence works on /partner-engineer, /dashboard (master-admin redirect), and /svc/engineer. No-token bounce + public root marketing both work as expected. No follow-up testing needed for this iter unless App.js loading gate is touched again.
rca of the issue: BUG (pre-fix): iOS Safari reloading a backgrounded /partner-engineer tab booted with user=null while /auth/me was in flight; App.js loading gate only shows the splash for an allowlist of protected routes and /partner-engineer was missing, so the route guard `user ? <PartnerDashboard/> : <Navigate to=/login>` rendered immediately and bounced the user. FIX VERIFIED: App.js now (1) adds /partner-engineer and /partners to protectedPrefixes and (2) also shows the splash whenever a session token exists in localStorage (hasSessionToken), regardless of route — so guards never render until /auth/me resolves. Reload on /partner-engineer with a token stays put; reload without a token still redirects to /login (gate doesn't trap).
